title: Heading of the admins' Settings › Secrets page: API keys and passwords that workspace apps and plugins read while they run.
intro: Security wording, keep it precise. "Sealed with the data key": encrypted with the server's data encryption key. "Write-only": a saved value can never be displayed again. A "manifest" is the file where an app or plugin declares what it needs; "grant" means give one app or plugin permission to read a secret.
loading: Shown while the Secrets page loads.
when: A date and time on this page; only formats it.
workload: An app's or plugin's name ({{name}}); the _plugin form marks it as a plugin. A "workload" is an app or plugin that runs on the server.
plugin: Small gray marker after a plugin's name, in a badge.
cancel: Button that closes the new secret or replace value form without saving.
ago.justNow: How long ago a secret's value was set: under a minute. See ago.minutes.
ago.minutes: How long ago a secret's value was set, in a narrow column: "just now", minutes (abbreviated "min"), hours (abbreviated "h"), then days ("yesterday", "3 days ago"); after 30 days a date: "on Oct 2", or with the year (_otherYear) when it is another year. Keep it short.
ago.hours: How long ago a secret's value was set, in hours (abbreviated "h"). See ago.minutes.
ago.days: How long ago a secret's value was set, in days ("yesterday", "3 days ago"); {{days}} is formatted for your language. See ago.minutes.
ago.on: When a secret's value was set, after 30 days: "on" and a short date; the _otherYear form adds the year. See ago.minutes.
value.label: Screen-reader label of the write-only field for a secret's value; {{name}} is the secret's name (an identifier such as STRIPE_API_KEY). _unnamed: before a name is typed.
value.placeholder: Placeholder of the value field: the value can be entered but never read back.
new.title: Button that opens the form to add a secret, and that form's accessible name.
new.set: Screen-reader label of the form that sets a value for a secret an app declares; {{name}} is the secret's name.
new.name: Accessible name of the field for the new secret's name.
new.namePlaceholder: Placeholder: secret names are uppercase identifiers. Keep NAME and STRIPE_API_KEY as they are; translate "e.g.".
new.nameHint: Error under the name field when the name is invalid. Keep UPPER_CASE and _ as they are: they describe the allowed characters.
new.owner: Screen-reader label of the select of who owns the secret: the whole workspace (then granted to apps one by one) or a single app or plugin.
new.ownerWorkspace: Option: the secret belongs to the workspace and can be granted to apps and plugins.
new.only: Option and badge: the secret belongs to one app or plugin only; {{name}} is its name.
new.description: Accessible name of the field for the new secret's description.
new.descriptionPlaceholder: Placeholder of the optional description field in the new secret form: a short note on what the secret is used for.
new.save: Button that saves the new secret.
new.saved: Toast after a secret was saved; {{name}} is its name.
replace.label: Accessible name of the form that replaces a secret's value. {{name}} is the secret's name.
replace.open: Button that opens the form to replace a secret's value with a new version; the ellipsis says a form follows.
replace.value: Accessible name of the new value field. {{name}} is the secret's name.
replace.old: Screen-reader label of the select of how long the old value stays readable after a replace.
replace.action: Button that saves the new value.
replace.done: Toast after a secret's value was replaced; {{name}} is its name.
overlap.now: Option of how long the previous value keeps working after a replace: stop it at once. See overlap.minutes.
overlap.minutes: Options of how long the previous value keeps working after a replace, so running apps can switch over: retire it now, or keep it for a number of minutes, hours or days.
overlap.hours: Option of how long the previous value keeps working after a replace, in hours. See overlap.minutes.
overlap.days: Option of how long the previous value keeps working after a replace, in days. See overlap.minutes.
flags.label: Screen-reader label of the list of read flags: warnings about unusual reads of secrets.
flags.labelOn: Screen-reader label of the read flags of one secret; {{name}} is its name.
flags.title: Heading of the list of read flags: automatic warnings about unusual reads of secrets.
flags.explanation: Explains read flags: automatic warnings drawn from the audit log. Dismissing one keeps it on record; it fires again only on new evidence.
flags.rule.read-spike: Flag rule: an app or plugin read a secret far more often than usual.
flags.rule.read-after-revoke: Flag rule: an app or plugin kept trying to read a secret after its permission was taken away.
flags.rule.stale-identity: Flag rule: a plugin keeps using an old identity token after a rotation.
flags.dismissed: Shown on a dismissed flag: {{name}} is the admin who dismissed it (or "an admin"), <when></when> the date and time (keep the tags).
flags.anAdmin: Stands in for {{name}} in "Dismissed by {{name}}" when the admin is no longer known.
flags.dismiss: Button on a read flag: marks it as seen; it stays on record.
flags.dismissLabel: Screen-reader label of the Dismiss button; {{name}} is the app or plugin the flag is about.
flags.seen: When a flag's pattern was first and last seen; <first></first> and <last></last> are dates and times (keep the tags).
history.open: Button on a secret's row: shows its versions, reads and events.
history.label: Screen-reader label of a secret's History button and panel; {{name}} is the secret's name.
history.loading: Shown while a secret's history loads.
history.versions: Heading in a secret's history: the versions of its value.
history.version: A version of a secret's value: {{version}} its number, then its state in parentheses (current: served now; previous: still readable for a while; retired: no longer served), {{name}} who set it and <when></when> when. _previousUntil adds until when the previous value stays readable. Keep the tags.
history.reads: Heading in a secret's history and column heading: how many times each app or plugin read it.
history.noReads: Shown in a secret's history panel, under the Reads heading, when no app or plugin has read the secret or been refused a read.
history.readsLabel: Accessible name of the reads table. {{name}} is the secret's name.
history.workload: Column heading in the reads table: the app or plugin that read the secret.
history.firstRead: Column heading in the reads table: when the app or plugin first read the secret.
history.lastRead: Column heading in the reads table: when the app or plugin last read the secret.
history.refused: Column heading: how many reads were refused (not permitted).
history.refusedLast: Refused column: {{count}} refused reads, then when the last one happened (<when></when>, keep the tags).
history.events: Heading in a secret's history: what was done to it and by whom.
history.eventsLabel: Accessible name of the events list. {{name}} is the secret's name.
history.event: One event in a secret's history: {{actor}} is who did it, {{detail}} a description from the server (not translated).
history.older: Button under the events list: loads older events.
events.created: Event badge: the secret was made.
events.replaced: Event badge: the secret's value was replaced.
events.first-read: Event: an app or plugin read the secret for the first time.
events.described: Event: the secret's description was edited.
events.deleted: Event badge: the secret was deleted.
events.granted: Event: an app or plugin was given permission to read the secret.
events.revoked: Event: an app's or plugin's permission to read the secret was taken away.
row.workspace: Badge on a secret that belongs to the whole workspace.
row.current: A secret's current value: {{version}} its version number, {{name}} who set it, <when></when> when (keep the tags).
row.noCurrent: On a secret's row when it has no value in use now.
row.previous: The previous value, still readable: {{version}} its number, <when></when> until when. Lowercase: follows a " · " separator.
row.lastRead: Last read: {{name}} is the app or plugin (or "an app"), <when></when> when. Lowercase: follows a " · " separator.
row.anApp: Stands in for {{name}} in "last read by {{name}}" when the reader is no longer known.
row.neverRead: No app or plugin has read the secret yet. Lowercase: follows a " · " separator.
row.delete: Button on a secret's row: deletes the secret, after a confirmation.
row.deleteLabel: Accessible name of the Delete button. {{name}} is the secret's name.
row.deleteConfirm: Browser confirmation before deleting a secret; {{name}} is its name. Security wording: reads stop and grants end at once; the encrypted versions are kept for the audit record.
row.readersLabel: Accessible name of the list of apps and plugins granted a secret. {{name}} is the secret's name.
row.readBy: Label before the badges of apps and plugins granted this secret.
row.noReaders: No app or plugin has been granted the secret yet. Lowercase, after "Read by:".
row.revokeLabel: Screen-reader label of the × on a grant badge; {{secret}} is the secret's name, {{app}} the app or plugin.
row.grantLabel: Screen-reader label of the select that grants this secret to another app or plugin; {{name}} is the secret's name.
row.grantTo: First, empty option of the grant select.
identity.about: Footer of a plugin's card. The "service identity" is the token a plugin's service uses to sign in to the product; {{name}} is the plugin's name. "Rotate": replace it with a new token.
identity.rotate: Button on a plugin's card: replaces the plugin's service identity (its sign-in token) with a new one.
identity.rotateLabel: Screen-reader label of the Rotate identity button; {{name}} is the plugin's name.
identity.confirm: Browser confirmation before rotating; {{name}} is the plugin's name. The old token keeps working for 15 minutes.
identity.rotated: Toast after a rotation; {{name}} is the plugin's name; _version adds the new identity's version number.
declared.required: Badge: the app or plugin needs this secret to work.
declared.optional: Badge: the app or plugin can work without this secret.
declared.set: State of a declared secret: it has a value. Followed by how long ago it was set.
declared.workspaceSecret: Under "Set": the value comes from a workspace-wide secret granted to this app.
declared.notSet: State of a secret an app or plugin declares: it has no value yet.
declared.grantShared: Button: grant this app the workspace's secret of the same name ("the workspace's" stands for "the workspace's secret"). Keep it short: it fits a narrow column.
declared.setValue: Button that opens the form to set this secret's value; the ellipsis says a form follows.
declared.setValueLabel: Screen-reader label of the Set a value button; {{name}} is the secret's name.
app.plugin: Badge after a plugin's name on its card.
app.needsSetup: Badge: the app or plugin still lacks a required secret.
app.ready: Badge: every required secret of the app or plugin is set.
app.progress: How many of the required secrets have a value: {{set}} of {{count}}.
app.none: Shown on an app's or plugin's card when it needs no secrets.
app.declaresLabel: Screen-reader label of an app's list of declared secrets; {{name}} is the app's name.
apps.title: Heading of the list of workspace apps and the secrets each declares.
apps.label: Accessible name of the list of apps.
plugins.title: Heading of the list of plugins and the secrets each declares.
plugins.label: Accessible name of the list of plugins.
all.title: Heading of the list of every secret in the workspace.
all.empty: Shown in All secrets when there are none.
errors.load: Error toast when the Secrets page could not load its list of secrets. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.save: Error toast when saving a new secret from the new secret form failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.replace: Error toast when replacing a secret's value with a new version failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.dismiss: Error toast when dismissing a read flag (a warning about unusual reads of a secret) failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.history: Error toast when a secret's history panel (versions, reads and events) could not load. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.older: Error toast after the button that loads older events in a secret's history, when loading failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.delete: Error toast when deleting a secret failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.revoke: Error toast when taking a secret's grant away from an app or plugin (the × on its badge) failed. "It" is the grant. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.grant: Error toast when granting a secret to an app or plugin (permission to read it) failed. "It" is the secret. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
errors.rotate: Error toast when rotating a plugin's service identity (replacing its sign-in token with a new one) failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
